clusters.reason: All three describe a hand held at the front of the mouth; same visible property.
Both describe hands at the central face (eyes/nose/cheeks); defined as both hands there together to separate blow_nose/glasses from one-handed mouth actions.
Redundant with hand_at_mouth, both_hands_at_face and hand_beside_head; hands_at_head_level is too generic (about 28 actions) and adds no separation.

Ear, temple and side-of-forehead positions are adjacent and touching vs. hovering cannot be told reliably from joints; merged into one side-of-head location. salute vs phone_call stays separable via elbow_raised_high.
All require the hand to reach the crown of the head; onto/off direction is left to the combination with hands_move_apart/hands_come_together and temporal order.
P2: positives are essentially neck_pain (plus brush_hair in passing); renamed action.
Identical property: the two hands of one person meet.
All describe a still base hand and a working hand near it; key for counting_money/open_bottle/bag actions vs reading.
Same property: hand resting on the front of one's own torso.
Contact and location versions describe the same hand position beside the own hip/upper thigh (lower back included).
Same property: hand behind the plane of the own torso.
Touching the foot vs reaching near the floor is not reliably separable from joints; both mean hands at foot/floor height. Separates pick_up from drop.
Crossed forearms always put each hand across the midline; forearms_cross alone is near P2 (cross_arms/cross_hands_in_front pair), so folded into the broader midline attribute.
Head moving toward a raised hand and head bowed toward the hands are the same visible head-down-toward-hands posture.
Same property: one arm carries the motion, the other is still.
Same property: mirrored simultaneous arm motion.
Same property: motion at wrists/hands with fixed elbows and shoulders.
Forearm swings, oscillations and rubbing strokes share the visible pattern of a hand moving back and forth along a short path; whether it touches the body is covered by contact attributes.
Sideways head turning/tilting is either the main motion (shake_head, neck_pain) or a minor accompaniment; folded into head-as-main-mover to avoid an inconsistently applied small-tilt attribute.
Alternating and joint leg flexion are sub-cases of legs carrying the motion; finer leg patterns are covered by whole_body attributes.
Too generic and fully covered by torso_bent_forward, torso_twists and head_tilted_back (which includes leaning back).
One leg moving, one-leg stance and leg kicks all share the visible fact that one foot is off the floor while the other leg supports; kick-only attributes would be P2 (kicking family).
Straight arm, extended arm and hand far in front are the same visible configuration; two-arm push alone would be P2 (pushing).
Covered by fast_arm_swing, arms_out_to_sides and arm_extends_forward; adds no separation for hard pairs.
Wind-up then fast long swing is one visible pattern; the horizontal sweep alone is near P2 (tennis_bat_swing).
Raising the arms overhead, holding them overhead and hands active above the head all reduce to hands higher than the head.
P1: rotation about the forearm axis is only weakly visible through noisy thumb/hand-tip joints; thumb_up/thumb_down separation is kept via hand_upright (inferred), keeping inferred attributes few.
Same property in all runs; separates put_object_into_bag from take_object_out_of_bag.
Same property: hand pulled back toward the own torso as a main phase.
Same property: inter-hand distance shrinks.
Same property: inter-hand distance grows; with hands_come_together it separates put_on/take_off glasses and headphones.
P2: large circles are essentially arm_circles; small circular rubbing is covered by repeated_short_strokes.
Depends on fine finger/wrist motion and covers only snap_fingers/toss_a_coin; covered by wrist_hand_dominant + sudden_fast_motion + single_occurrence.
Hunched/rounded shoulders co-occur with a forward-bent torso in all positives and are hard to judge separately; merged.
Leaning the upper torso back and tipping the head back share positives (cheer_up, yawn, stretch_oneself); merged into one backward-tilt attribute.
Same posture.
Deep knee bend, lowering hips and ending low are the same downward hip motion; ending-on-ground alone would be P2 (falling_down/knock_over).
Same property; with hips_lower it separates sit_down from stand_up.
Same posture.
All describe shoulders rotating relative to hips (with or without arm).
Small accompanying lean in heterogeneous actions (whisper, side_kick, stretch) that annotators cannot apply consistently; covered by on_one_leg and unsteady_sway where it matters.
Single proposal kept as the one inferred attribute that separates thumb_up/victory/OK signs from thumb_down.
Single proposal kept: groups the hand-sign actions and separates them from point_to_something and salute.
Same location; sharpened to both hands close together so it separates reading/phone from writing/typing.
Same location.
Same location.
Same temporal property.
Defined by a repetition count (two or three), which is a numeric threshold; the boundary with single_occurrence and many_steady_repeats is not applied consistently.
Same temporal property.
Raise-and-hold and a held pose mid-action are the same reach/pause/return pattern.
Differs from raise_hold_lower visibly: the pose is kept for most of the clip rather than a short pause (phone_call/reading vs thumb_up/salute).
Short jerks are sudden fast movements of the head/torso; merged into one abrupt-fast attribute.
Slowness is relative and subject-dependent; without a threshold it is not applied consistently, and positives are heterogeneous.
Same property; separates play_with_phone_tablet/writing from reading.
ends_in_new_state is covered by hips_lower, hips_rise, walks_across_floor and distance attributes; returns_to_start_pose is too generic (about 55 actions).
Same sequential left-then-right pattern.
Shoulder shrug/roll is small relative to joint noise and its positives (jacket/bag) are already covered by hands_behind_torso and one_side_then_other; shrug_at_end is near P2.
Same property.
In-place leg cycles and whole-body bouncing have the same positives (run_on_the_spot, butt_kicks, hopping).
Same property.
Same property.
Weight is only indirectly visible through hip/foot position and the shift co-occurs with fast_arm_swing and on_one_leg; not worth an inferred slot.
Too generic (50-55 of 120) and is the complement of legs_carry_motion/walks_across_floor.
Same spatial relation; separates pat_on_back/touch_pocket from punch_slap.
Among two-person actions it is the complement of beside_or_behind_partner and holds for most of them; redundant.
Brief meet-then-withdraw is the typical timing of hands meeting between two people; merged.
Equivalent to sudden_fast_motion combined with touches_partner_upper_body/lower_body and partner_recoils; would duplicate them.
Stepping backward is the partner's recoil in all positives (pushing, kicking, wield_knife).
Same property; renamed to drop the intention word 'block'. Separates hit_with_object/wield_knife from pushing/kicking.
Same property.
Same property.
Same property; separates shaking_hands/hugging from high-five/punch.
Same property; separates follow from walking_towards/walking_apart.
Same property; separates exchange_things from giving_object.
Complement of both_same_motion among two-person actions; the reacting part is covered by partner_recoils and partner_raises_arms.
They differ in the height of the contact point on the partner (above vs below the waist), which is visible and separates pat_on_back from touch_pocket.
A negation of the contact attributes; aiming is covered by arm_extends_forward together with the absence of touches_partner_* and hands_meet_between.

dropped.name: arms_and_legs_together
dropped.reason: Too vague; 'large motion in arms and legs at once' is covered by legs_carry_motion plus arm attributes.

dropped.name: hand_on_opposite_arm
dropped.reason: Hand-on-forearm vs hand-on-hand is not reliably separable from joints; positives are heterogeneous and covered by hand_crosses_midline and hands_touch_each_other.

dropped.name: hand_tip_below_wrist
dropped.reason: P2: essentially thumb_down; its negation via hand_upright already separates thumb_up/thumb_down.

dropped.name: ends_with_hands_low_front
dropped.reason: Final hand position low in front is shared by many unrelated actions and does not reliably mark take-off actions.

dropped.name: small_foot_adjustments
dropped.reason: Small incidental steps occur in many recordings regardless of action; not applied consistently.

dropped.name: arms_hang_at_sides
dropped.reason: Negation of arm activity; covered by head_carries_motion and legs_carry_motion.

dropped.name: body_turns_around
dropped.reason: Rare and inconsistent (only some walking_apart or partner turns); covered by distance_increases.

dropped.name: forearms_horizontal_at_chest
dropped.reason: Near P2 (cross_arms, check_time_(from_watch)); covered by hand_crosses_midline and one_hand_raised_front.
